title: 90s themes
text: theme_gameboy() uses four shades green original Game Boy screen pixel font Press Start 2P, ships fmggp2. simulate starter chosen 300 Pokémon Red Blue players.
code: set.seed(1998) pokemon_starters <- data.frame(   starter = sample(c("Bulbasaur", "Charmander", "Squirtle"),     size = 300, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.30, 0.42, 0.28)) ) ggplot(pokemon_starters, aes(x = starter, fill = starter)) +   geom_bar(show.legend = FALSE) +   labs(title = "Pokemon Red and Blue (simulated)",        subtitle = "Starter chosen by 300 players",        x = "Starter", y = "Count") +   theme_gameboy(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_win98() draws plot Windows 98 window sitting teal desktop. title sits navy title bar, plot area white, bars lines navy default. simulate 300 AOL dial sessions (minutes) normal distribution.  Discrete fills follow desktop palette (gray, navy, teal).
code: set.seed(1014) aol_sessions <- data.frame(   minutes = round(rnorm(n = 300, mean = 45, sd = 12)) ) ggplot(aol_sessions, aes(x = minutes)) +   geom_histogram(bins = 30) +   labs(title = "AOL dial up sessions (simulated)",        subtitle = "Distribution of session length",        x = "Session length (minutes)") +   theme_win98(base_size = 13) aol_ranges <- data.frame(   range = factor(c("under 33", "33 to 56", "57 and over"),                  levels = c("under 33", "33 to 56", "57 and over")),   n = c(47, 193, 60) ) ggplot(aol_ranges, aes(x = n, y = "300 sessions", fill = range)) +   geom_col(position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +   labs(x = "Number of sessions", y = NULL, fill = "Minutes") +   theme_win98(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_napster() borrows dark 1999 Napster client: near black window, white text, dotted gray grid, lime marks. simulate 300 MP3 downloads 56k modem right skewed gamma distribution.
code: set.seed(1999) napster_downloads <- data.frame(   minutes = round(rgamma(n = 300, shape = 4, rate = 0.5), 1) ) ggplot(napster_downloads, aes(x = minutes)) +   geom_freqpoly(bins = 30) +   labs(title = "Napster MP3 downloads (simulated)",        subtitle = "Download time over a 56k modem",        x = "Download time (minutes)") +   theme_napster(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_blockbuster() uses Blockbuster Video blue yellow. simulate weekly rentals 60 households Poisson distribution.
code: set.seed(1993) blockbuster_rentals <- data.frame(rentals = rpois(n = 60, lambda = 3)) ggplot(blockbuster_rentals, aes(x = rentals)) +   geom_dotplot(binwidth = 1, dotsize = 0.3) +   labs(title = "Blockbuster Video (simulated)",        x = "Number of rentals") +   theme_blockbuster(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_spice() uses hot pink, purple, gold. simulate ages 400 fans 1998 concert mix kids parents.
code: set.seed(1998) kid <- runif(400) < 0.65 spice_fans <- data.frame(age = round(ifelse(kid, rnorm(400, 11, 2.5), rnorm(400, 37, 6)))) ggplot(spice_fans, aes(x = age)) +   geom_density() +   labs(title = "Spice World tour (simulated)",        x = "Age (years)") +   theme_spice(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_beanie() uses red gold Beanie Babies heart tag. simulate 300 resale prices log normal distribution.
code: set.seed(1996) beanie_prices <- data.frame(price = rlnorm(n = 300, meanlog = log(15), sdlog = 0.8)) ggplot(beanie_prices, aes(x = "", y = price)) +   geom_violin() +   labs(title = "Beanie Babies resale prices (simulated)",        x = NULL, y = "Price (USD)") +   theme_beanie(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_n64() uses controller gray four logo colors. simulate 200 Mario Kart 64 lap times heavy tailed t distribution.
code: set.seed(64) mario_kart_laps <- data.frame(seconds = 45 + 2 * rt(n = 200, df = 3)) ggplot(mario_kart_laps, aes(x = "", y = seconds)) +   geom_boxplot() +   labs(title = "Mario Kart 64 (simulated)",        x = NULL, y = "Lap time (seconds)") +   theme_n64(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_jurassic() uses park gate black, jungle green, logo red amber. simulate total weight dinosaurs paddock.
code: set.seed(1993) jp_paddocks <- data.frame(species = c("Brachiosaurus", "Triceratops", "Tyrannosaurus"),   total_tons = c(sum(rnorm(3, 40, 5)), sum(rnorm(5, 9, 1.2)), sum(rnorm(2, 8, 1)))) ggplot(jp_paddocks, aes(x = species, y = total_tons, fill = species)) +   geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +   labs(title = "Jurassic Park (simulated)", x = "Paddock", y = "Total weight (tons)") +   theme_jurassic(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_happymeal() uses red yellow Happy Meal box. simulate average daily Happy Meal sales four toy promotions.
code: set.seed(1997) happy_meals <- data.frame(promotion = c("Teenie Beanie Babies", "Furby", "Hot Wheels", "Inspector Gadget"),   avg_sold = sapply(c(420, 310, 220, 180), function(l) mean(rpois(28, l)))) ggplot(happy_meals, aes(x = promotion, y = avg_sold, fill = promotion)) +   geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +   labs(title = "Happy Meals (simulated)", x = "Toy promotion", y = "Average sold per day") +   theme_happymeal(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_friends() uses Monica’s purple walls, yellow frame, logo dot colors. simulate viewers per episode three seasons.
code: set.seed(1994) friends_episodes <- data.frame(season = rep(c("Season 1", "Season 3", "Season 5"), each = 24)) friends_episodes$viewers_m <- round(rnorm(72, rep(c(22, 27, 24), each = 24), 2.5)) ggplot(friends_episodes, aes(x = viewers_m, fill = season)) +   geom_bar() +   labs(title = "Friends (simulated)", x = "Viewers (millions)", y = "Episodes", fill = "Season") +   theme_friends(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_freshprince() puts graffiti neon deep purple, continuous fill runs teal hot pink. simulate often Carlton dance shows season.
code: set.seed(1990) fp <- expand.grid(season = 1:6, gag = c("Will flirts", "Carlton dance")) fp$occurrences <- rbinom(12, 24, ifelse(fp$gag == "Will flirts", 0.9, plogis(-2.2 + 0.5 * (fp$season - 3.5)))) ggplot(fp, aes(x = season, y = gag, fill = occurrences)) +   geom_tile() +   labs(title = "Fresh Prince (simulated)", x = "Season", y = NULL, fill = "Episodes") +   theme_freshprince(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_pogs() uses cardboard background bright milk cap prints. simulate collection 100 Pogs.
code: set.seed(1993) pogs <- data.frame(type = sample(c("Milk caps", "Printed pogs", "Holographic", "Slammers"),   100, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.45, 0.30, 0.15, 0.10))) ggplot(pogs, aes(x = type, fill = type)) +   geom_bar(show.legend = FALSE) +   labs(title = "A Pogs collection (simulated)", x = NULL, y = "Pieces") +   theme_pogs(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_walkman() uses silver body, black tape window, sports yellow orange. simulate median battery life three models two battery types.
code: set.seed(1979) walkman <- data.frame(model = rep(c("WM-2", "WM-F45 Sports", "WM-EX194 Mega Bass"), times = 2),   battery = rep(c("Alkaline", "Rechargeable"), each = 3), hours = c(10, 16, 22, 7, 12, 17) + rnorm(6, 0, 0.5)) ggplot(walkman, aes(x = hours, y = model)) +   geom_line(aes(group = model)) +   geom_point(aes(color = battery), size = 3) +   labs(title = "Sony Walkman (simulated)", x = "Median battery life (hours)", y = NULL, color = "Battery") +   theme_walkman(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_encarta(): Encarta Encyclopedia Britannica CD-ROM, midnight navy, parchment, gold, blue, maroon Georgia title.
code: p_encarta <- 0.8 * plogis(-2 + 0.6 * (0:6)) enc <- data.frame(year = factor(rep(1993:1999, 2)),   choice = rep(c("Encarta", "Britannica"), each = 7),   share = c(p_encarta, -(0.8 - p_encarta))) ggplot(enc, aes(x = year, y = share, fill = choice)) +   geom_col(width = 0.5) +   labs(title = "Encarta vs. Britannica (simulated)", x = NULL, y = "Share", fill = NULL) +   theme_encarta(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_netscape(): Netscape Navigator night sky star yellow, teal, magenta, meteor orange Times New Roman title.
code: set.seed(1996) modem <- sample(c("14.4k", "28.8k", "56k"), 600, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.25, 0.45, 0.30)) speeds <- data.frame(modem = modem,   kbps = rnorm(600, c(`14.4k` = 13, `28.8k` = 26, `56k` = 44)[modem], c(`14.4k` = 1.2, `28.8k` = 2.5, `56k` = 5)[modem])) ggplot(speeds, aes(x = kbps, after_stat(count), fill = modem)) +   geom_density(position = "fill") +   labs(title = "Dial up speeds (simulated)", x = "Speed (kbps)", fill = "Modem") +   theme_netscape(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_titanic(): Titanic (1997) ocean navy, iceberg white, steel blue, gold, funnel red Big Caslon title.
code: set.seed(1997) fans <- data.frame(age_group = sample(c("Teen", "Adult"), 300, replace = TRUE),   viewings = sample(c("Once", "Twice", "3+ times"), 300, replace = TRUE)) ggplot(fans, aes(x = age_group, fill = viewings)) +   geom_bar(position = "fill") +   labs(title = "Titanic (simulated)", x = NULL, y = "Share", fill = "Viewings") +   theme_titanic(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_lisafrank(): Lisa Frank hot pink rainbow neon marks Chalkboard title.
code: set.seed(1993) keepers <- data.frame(design = sample(c("Rainbow leopards", "Unicorns", "Dolphins", "Pandas"),   200, replace = TRUE, prob = c(1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/8))) ggplot(keepers, aes(x = design, fill = design)) +   geom_bar(show.legend = FALSE) +   labs(title = "Trapper Keepers (simulated)", x = NULL, y = "Sold") +   theme_lisafrank(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_toysrus(): Toys”R”Us white blue multicolored logo letters marks Phosphate title.
code: set.seed(1999) toys <- data.frame(toy = c("Furby", "Beanie Babies", "Game Boy Color", "Nintendo 64"),   units = rpois(4, c(1800, 2400, 1200, 1000))) ggplot(toys, aes(x = toy, y = units, fill = toy)) +   geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +   labs(title = "Toys\"R\"Us 1998 (simulated)", x = NULL, y = "Units sold") +   theme_toysrus(base_size = 13)

title: 90s themes
text: theme_gameboy() uses Press Start 2P, ships fmggp2. themes use fonts ship macOS Windows. themes use single font family: Tahoma (theme_win98()) Verdana (theme_napster()) Trebuchet MS (theme_spice()) Comic Sans MS (theme_beanie()) themes use Arial body text display font title: Impact (theme_blockbuster()) Arial Black (theme_n64() theme_freshprince()) Herculanum (theme_jurassic()) Arial Rounded (theme_happymeal()) Chalkduster (theme_friends()) Bradley Hand (theme_pogs()) DIN Condensed (theme_walkman()) Georgia (theme_encarta()) Times New Roman (theme_netscape()) Big Caslon (theme_titanic()) Chalkboard (theme_lisafrank()) Phosphate (theme_toysrus()) font file can’t found, theme falls back "sans", plots still render Linux. can also pass family ’ve registered sysfonts::font_add():
code: theme_win98(base_family = "sans")
